Name: Lynn's Livingroom (For Furniture Framework)
Author: LynnNexus
Description:
[size=5][center][b]Mod Basics﻿[/b][/center][/size][size=4]The quick and dirty of this is that this is a 1.6 update for my mod [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12103]Tufted Chairs for DGA[/url].[/size]

The less quick is that DGA was never going to update to 1.6 and sadly that left me, and my chairs, out in the cold.  Not only does vanilla restrict what shapes you can make your rotations (Where you right click to turn the furniture) it also didn't allow me to dictate where and when seats would exist... And I'm gonna be honest that was one of the biggest reasons why I wanted my furniture to be it's own thing, so my butt wasn't clipping through armrests and my legs would look comfortable.

BUT!  Furniture Framework to the rescue!  It's still a developing mod so as of right this instant I won't be able to bring my Bedroom furniture forward but with the rate that FF is updating?  I'm pretty sure that the beds are close behind my chairs.

[center][size=5][b]Anything new?[/b][/size][/center]Why yes!  So glad you asked!
As of this moment we have a coffee table and a new fabric color (white/silver depending on your monitor)! 
The new table comes complete with the ability to put your magazines on it!  I know that doesn't seem like much, but, Table spots are a thing that's been added to FF and much like seat position, I'm having SO much fun playing with it. 

[s]As of right this instant we can only have one slot on an item... BUT!  in the future!!! It sounds like we'll be able to designate more than one spot so a Curio Cabinet might be in our future!!  I'm way too excited here XD[/s] Both of these things exist!

[size=4]New stuff notes:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]So we have the fact that you have to right click to place things in table spots.[/size]
[*][size=2]Now that we can have multiple table spots, I've added rotations to the coffee table.  It goes Horizontal with one slot, Vertical one, Horizontal with two, vertical two.  You may need to get a new copy of the table if you want this new function though.[/size]
[*][size=2]We have a book shelf now!  It's pretty big but it will accept up to 12 1x1 items (like seed bags or the new books)[/size]
[/list]

[size=5][b][center]Installing and Use[/center][/b][/size]Pretty standard TBH
1 Download this mod and FF
2 Unzip both into your mods folder
3 Profit 

[b]Returning users[/b], first off, sorry it took so long!  I hope you weren't waiting on me to jump to 1.6!!
If you are advancing a character with my stuff from 1.5.6 to 1.6, you're gonna wanna remove the old stuff before you do the jump because you will have weirdness going on. Then you're gonna have to delete my old mod and follow the above instructions. 
With the change from DGA to FF, there can't be a direct replacement.  So, sadly, out with the old versions in with the new.

[center][size=5][b]The Other Stuff[/b][/size][/center][b]Compatibility[/b] should be no issue, since we're not overwriting anything.
[b]Translations[/b] are welcomed but I speak English and Bad English so I am not your girl for that.
[b]Support[/b] is now possible through my [url=http://Ko-fi.com/lynn_nexus]Kofi[/url]
And last but not least, I only put my mods here on Nexus so if you see my stuff elsewhere, please shun it.
